title: Residential Natural Gas Supply Household Tenure Reduction — Questions Answered
content:
**What decides the household tenure reduction on a premise added to a Residential Natural Gas Supply household?**
The household tenure reduction depends on the calendar days from the home agreement's service start date to the enrollment date: 0.0080 per therm when they are 730 or more, 0.0040 per therm when they are at least 365 but fewer than 730, and none when they are fewer than 365. The reduction lowers the household rate by that amount per therm.

**Which service start date is read?**
The service start date on the home agreement — the customer's gas agreement at the premise of the mailing address — not the start of any other agreement.

**What are the bands?**

| Days from the home agreement's service start date to the enrollment date | Reduction per therm |
|---|---|
| 730 or more | 0.0080 |
| 365 to 729 | 0.0040 |
| fewer than 365 | none |

**How do the edges fall?** (hypothetical spans)
A span of exactly 730 days earns 0.0080 and a span of 729 days earns 0.0040; a span of exactly 365 days earns 0.0040 and a span of 364 days earns none.
